ruleDefinitions.name: Classes Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Classes.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Folder\\\\ShellEx\\\\ExtShellFolderViews.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Folder\\\\ShellEx\\\\DragDropHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Folder\\\\Shellex\\\\ColumnHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Filter.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Exefile\\\\Shell\\\\Open\\\\Command\\\\\\(Default\\).*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Directory\\\\Shellex\\\\DragDropHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Directory\\\\Shellex\\\\CopyHookHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CLSID\\\\\\{AC757296\\-3522\\-4E11\\-9862\\-C17BE5A1767E\\}\\\\Instance.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CLSID\\\\\\{ABE3B9A4\\-257D\\-4B97\\-BD1A\\-294AF496222E\\}\\\\Instance.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CLSID\\\\\\{7ED96837\\-96F0\\-4812\\-B211\\-F13C24117ED3\\}\\\\Instance.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CLSID\\\\\\{083863F1\\-70DE\\-11d0\\-BD40\\-00A0C911CE86\\}\\\\Instance.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Classes\\\\AllFileSystemObjects\\\\ShellEx\\\\DragDropHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.exe.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.cmd.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ShellEx\\\\PropertySheetHandlers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ShellEx\\\\ContextMenuHandlers.*"))) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)" OR Details = "\{807583E5\-5146\-11D5\-A672\-00B0D022E945\}" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\drvinst\.exe" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\lnkfile\\\\shellex\\\\ContextMenuHandlers\\\\.*")))
